What if one choice changes everything?

Imagine a fictional city where every street hides a completely different story. Nothing here is an official announcement or a promise of features.

Our original idea starts with an ordinary character exploring a place they have never visited. Their smallest decision changes which person they encounter next.

In this imaginary scenario, the city reacts to that decision with unexpected characters, changing weather, and a completely new path forward.

It is interesting because familiar open worlds can inspire completely different kinds of storytelling. Players might imagine their own challenges, surprises, and adventures.

Would you rather explore a mysterious city alone or discover its secrets with friends? Share the kind of story you would create.
